name_vi: Bộ Nông nghiệp và Môi trường
predecessors: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MARD) + Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE)
units_relevant_to_alt_protein: Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health (Cuc Chan nuoi va Thu y, DLPAH); Department of Fisheries and Fisheries Surveillance (Cuc Thuy san va Kiem ngu, DFFI); Department of Quality, Processing and Market Development; Department of Nature Conservation and Biodiversity; Department of Climate Change; Department of Environment; Department of Science and Technology
sector_roles: Feed and aquafeed (permitted lists, feed trials, QCVN 01-190); primary agri-food safety; GMO biosafety certificates incl. closed production of GM microbes (Decree 43/2026); access to genetic resources (Decree 59/2017); EIA; carbon market and GHG inventory
notes: Unit list taken from wave 1 reading of Decree 35/2025 (REG-42), not re-read here. Livestock and veterinary were merged into one department (DLPAH).

name_vi: Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ
predecessors: MOST + Ministry of Information and Communications (MIC)
units_relevant_to_alt_protein: Department of Science and Technology; Department of Technology Assessment and Appraisal; Bureau of Intellectual Property; National Committee for Standards, Metrology and Quality (ex-STAMEQ); Bureau of Digital Transformation; Institute of Science and Technology Strategy
sector_roles: STI law (93/2025) incl. controlled testing sandbox; High Technology Law (133/2025) and high-tech lists (Decision 23/2026); strategic technologies (Decision 21/2026); TCVN national standards; IP (patents, strains); halal certifier registration (Decree 127/2026)
notes: Decree 55/2025 replaces the prior MOST decree (2023) and MIC decree (2022). Standards body now a national committee under MOST.

predecessors: MOF + Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI)
legal_basis: Resolution 176/2025/QH15; Decree 29/2025/ND-CP (24 Feb 2025), amended by Decree 166/2025/ND-CP (30 Jun 2025)
units_relevant_to_alt_protein: Tax departments; foreign investment and enterprise development units (ex-MPI); General Statistics Office function now within MOF as the National Statistics Office (NSO)
sector_roles: CIT incentives (Law 67/2025; Decree 320/2025); investment law (Law 143/2025); investment support (Decree 182/2024); customs and import tariffs; national statistics
notes: Decree and amendment confirmed by title only; unit list not read. NSO placement under MOF from agent knowledge (Medium-Low); check nso.gov.vn.

predecessors: MOIT (unchanged name; absorbed some functions from other ministries)
units_relevant_to_alt_protein: Industry department; Energy/Electricity units; Trade remedies; Market surveillance (Department of Domestic Market Management and Development)
sector_roles: Biofuel (E10) roadmap (Circular 50/2025/TT-BCT per brief, not read); PDP8 electricity plan implementation; food safety for its product groups under Law 55/2010 (beverages, beer, milk products, vegetable oil, flour/starch, confectionery) until the new Food Safety Law; trade defence
notes: Title and date confirmed; unit list not read. Draft Food Safety Law would move food-safety focal role to MOH (wave 1, REG).

predecessors: MOH (unchanged name; took over some social-protection functions from MOLISA)
units_relevant_to_alt_protein: Food Safety Department (Cuc An toan thuc pham, VFA); Department of Preventive Medicine; National Institute for Food Control (NIFC)
sector_roles: Food Safety Law 55/2010 and Decree 15/2018 (self-declaration, registration); lead drafter of the revised Food Safety Law (NA vote targeted Oct 2026 session); food additives, health supplements, new-technology food
notes: Decree title and date confirmed; unit list not re-read. VFA role and draft law from wave 1 (REG-08, REG-09).

name_vi: Ủy ban nhân dân cấp tỉnh
legal_basis: Resolution 202/2025/QH15; Law on Organisation of Local Government 2025 (two-tier model); Decree 136/2025 (decentralisation)
units_relevant_to_alt_protein: Provincial Departments of Agriculture and Environment; Departments of Science and Technology; Departments of Health (food safety); Departments of Industry and Trade
sector_roles: Several feed and aquafeed procedures moved to provincial chairs (wave 1 REG-41); investment registration; EIA for smaller projects; commune level handles local certification
notes: District level abolished from 1 Jul 2025 (Resolution 60-NQ/TW). Local government law number not verified here.
